\begin{example} \end{example}[endpoints escaping to infinity]

Source: petersen:page-0191 ↗ lem:pet-ch5-uniform-neighborhood 1. ch5:5.2.8On $\{ (x,y)\mid -1<xy\} $, $t\mapsto (t,0)$ is a geodesic on all of $\mathbb R$ that is a limit as $\varepsilon \to 0$ of unit-speed geodesics $t\mapsto (t,-\varepsilon )$, each defined only on a finite interval whose endpoints tend to infinity, as required by section 2. \end{example}
